title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: correction limits, post-departure window and weight tolerance
content:
## Scope

This limits card sets out, for every Bills of Lading and Transport Documents type, how far a document may be changed once it has been issued: the maximum number of corrections after issuance per document, the maximum number of changes of the named consignee after issuance, the latest a correction may be requested counted in calendar days after the vessel's departure, and the largest change of gross weight accepted after departure, expressed as a percentage of the printed weight.

## Limits table

| Document type | Maximum corrections after issuance per document | Maximum changes of the named consignee after issuance | Correction window after departure (calendar days) | Gross weight tolerance after departure (percent of printed weight) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | 3 | 2 | 14 | 5 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | 5 | 3 | 21 | 5 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | 2 | 0 | 10 | 3 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | 2 | 0 | 7 | 3 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | 2 | 0 | 10 | 3 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | 1 | 0 | 5 | 2 |

## Reading the table

- A limit of 0 consignee changes means the named consignee cannot be changed after issuance on that type; this is the position on the AHL Straight, AHL Negotiable, AHL Combined Transport and AHL Switch Bills of Lading.
- The window is stated in calendar days after the carrying vessel departed.
- The tolerance is a percentage of the weight printed on the document.

## Hypothetical weight illustrations

These figures are hypothetical inputs chosen to show the percentage, not company data.

- A document of the AHL Straight Bill of Lading type printing a gross weight of 18,000 kg: 18,000 kg multiplied by 3 percent gives 540 kg, the largest change of gross weight accepted after departure.
- The same printed weight on an AHL Switch Bill of Lading: 18,000 kg multiplied by 2 percent gives 360 kg.
- The same printed weight on an AHL Electronic Bill of Lading: 18,000 kg multiplied by 5 percent gives 900 kg.

## Points of judgement

**Which type allows the most corrections after issuance?** The AHL Electronic Bill of Lading, with 5 per document and a 21-day window after departure.

**Which type has the shortest window?** The AHL Switch Bill of Lading, at 5 calendar days after departure, with a single correction after issuance allowed.
